finding.headline: DAI market depth within ±50 bps of the peg is $113,000 — 56% below its 2026-08-18 → 2026-09-01 baseline.

narrative.whatHappened: $113,000 of quoted market depth within ±50 bps of the peg.
narrative.whyItMatters: Less quoted liquidity is available near the peg than in the reference period. Latest peg-spread reading: −2.0 bps.

detail: Depth was below its fitted floor in 100% of 288 observations. The floor was calibrated for a 10% breach rate.
